# Handover: Corner Bakery
> v1 · Approved 2026-11-29 by the bakery owner

## What is handed over
- The bakery owner gets the source in `bakery.py` and the tests in `test_bakery.py`.
- `README.md` gives the commands to start the tool, place an order and open the list.

## Who receives it
- The bakery owner receives it and signs the handover.

## Announcing it
- The bakery owner tells customers at the counter.

## First weeks after go-live
- The bakery keeps the paper list for the first week.

## Running it
- The bakery owner starts it from the terminal.

## Maintenance and updates
- The bakery owner tells the builder about faults.

## Retiring it
- The bakery owner can finish open orders on paper and retire the tool.
